name: Weather
complete-description:
Current conditions from Open-Meteo — no API key, no account, nothing to sign up for. Reports temperature, condition, feels-like, today's high and low, humidity, and wind, with a Celsius/Fahrenheit toggle and a configurable refresh interval.

Which of those six fields matters most is up to you, not the module: an "Info order" setting lets you drag them into any order, and whatever's on top survives even a small tile — the rest appear as the tile has room. If Open-Meteo is briefly unreachable, the last known reading is shown rather than an error, clearly marked as such.
